about: From desktop-foundation 1.0 `hraness-companion` is an alias of `hraness-helper`. For every argv that is not a removed tray mode, both binaries print the same stdout and stderr bytes and exit with the same status; only `--version` names the binary that ran. The removed tray modes below are any argv starting `--state-dir` or `--check-protocol` (in 0.x, `--state-dir <dir>` ran the menu bar and `--check-protocol` its self-check), any argv starting `--foreground` (the flag product CLIs passed to their menu bar command), and no arguments; 0.x answered the other forms with an error, and 1.0 refuses them all with the clearer one. They draw nothing, read no stdin, print `refusalStdout` on stdout and a line starting with `refusalStderrPrefix` on stderr, and exit `refusalExit`. `hraness-helper` answers the same argv with `invalid-arguments` and exit 1, as in v0.8.1. The v0.8.1 cases named in `supersedesCompanionCases` are tray modes, so for `hraness-companion` this file replaces them; `hraness-helper` still keeps them.
refusalStderrPrefix: hraness-companion: the menu bar was removed in desktop-foundation 1.0. Run `<product> status --json` to watch a product from a script.
